simple.summary: בַּעַל פְּרָצִים (Baʻal Pᵉrâtsîym) means Baal-Peratsim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 14 11.

definitions.full: H1188. Baal Peratsim מְּרָצִים בַּ֫עַל proper name, of a location ( possessor of breaches ; or Baal of Perasim ? ) where David defeated Philistine 2Sam 5:20 (twice in verse); 1Chr 14:11 (twice in verse); site unknown.
definitions.rootNote: from 1167 and the plural of 6556 ; possessor of breaches;
